🎉 3rd Anniversary Celebration | Three Years, One
Incredible Journey!
Thank you for being part of Top Heroes and for
making these three years so special. ❤️ Leave your
3rd Anniversary wishes now!

📝 How to Participate
1. Leave your 3rd Anniversary wishes in the
comments.
2. Include your In-Game Name and Server ID.

🎁 Community Milestone Reward
When we reach 2,026 valid comments, we’ll unlock a
limited-edition 3rd Anniversary Sticker for everyone!
🎉

✨ Special Giveaway
Among all Lords who leave a valid anniversary
message across our official platforms, 5 lucky Lords
will be randomly selected to receive an official
limited-edition figure! 🏆

📅 Event Duration: September 10–17

🎁 Winner Selection
Winner selection and information collection will begin
after September 30. Winners will be notified via email
and in-game messages.

⚠️ Please Note
1. Comments unrelated to the anniversary theme will
not be eligible for the figure giveaway.
2. Please treat everyone with kindness and respect,
communicate reasonably, and work together to
maintain a friendly and harmonious community
environment.
3. Comments without an In-Game Name and Server
ID will still count toward the total comment goal, but
will not be eligible for the figure giveaway.
4. Winners who do not respond or complete the
required form within 7 days of notification will forfeit
their prize.
Please make sure all information provided is accurate.
Let’s celebrate this milestone together and look
forward to the adventures still to come! 🥳
